units: <cite ref="Chullin 94a:6">Ḥull. 94ᵃ</cite> <he>עבר במ׳</he> was crossing on a ferry-boat; <cite ref="Ketubot 105b:9">Keth. 105ᵇ</cite> <he>עבר במ׳</he> on a board (cmp. <cite ref="C01042"><he>גַּמְלָא</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Chullin 95a:12">Ḥull. 95ᵃ</cite> <he>הוה יתיב במ׳ וכ׳</he> was sitting by the ford of &c., v. <cite ref="A01634"><he>אִישְׁתַּטִּית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Chullin 95b:5">Ib. 95ᵇ</cite> <he>בדיק במ׳</he> made the readiness of a ferry-boat a foreboding test (whether it was auspicious to undertake the journey).
